skills.name: Funnel Health
skills.description:
Steal an enemy's life force, dealing |cffffff14375|r Magic Damage and healing you or |cffffff3|r other nearby allies for |cffffff35|r% of the damage inflicted every |cffffff2|r seconds for |cffffff10|r seconds.

Deals |cffffff1|r% more damage for every |cffffff2|r% Health you have.

skills.name: Twilight Matriarch Restore
skills.description:
Call on Azura to send a twilight matriarch to fight at your side. The twilight matriarch's zap deals |cffffff2319|r Shock Damage and its kick deals |cffffff2319|r Shock Damage.

Once summoned, you can activate the twilight matriarch's special ability for |cffffff3580|r Magicka, causing it to heal |cffffff2|r friendly targets for |cffffff22435|r and itself for |cffffff11217|r.

The twilight matriarch remains until killed or unsummoned.

skills.name: Equilibrium
skills.description:
Barter with Oblivion to trade vitality for power, sacrificing your Health in exchange for |cffffff3000|r Magicka.

The exchange reduces your healing done and damage shield strength by |cffffff50|r% for |cffffff4|r seconds.

skills.name: Degeneration
skills.description:
Bind an enemy with chaotic magic, dealing |cffffff31908|r Magic Damage over |cffffff22|r seconds.

Excess magic spills out from them, granting you Major Brutality, increasing your Weapon and Spell Damage by |cffffff20|r% for |cffffff22|r seconds.

skills.name: Inner Light
skills.description:
Conjure a mote of magelight, revealing stealthed and invisible enemies around you for |cffffff7|r seconds. Exposed enemies cannot return to stealth or invisibility for |cffffff4|r seconds. The light is so brilliant that you cannot conceal your presence while active.

While slotted gain Major Savagery, increasing Critical Chance by |cffffff12|r% and your Max Magicka is increased by |cffffff5|r%.

skills.name: Shooting Star
skills.description:
Call a comet down from the constellations to blast an enemy, dealing |cffffff28525|r Flame Damage to all enemies in the area, knocking them down, and stunning them for |cffffff2|r seconds.

One second after impact, enemies in the target area take |cffffff7731|r Flame Damage every |cffffff1|r second for |cffffff12|r seconds.

You generate |cffffff10|r Ultimate for each enemy hit by the initial blast, up to 6 times.
